Subject: Exec: proposed manager pivot & HR clearance needed

Team —

I wanted to share a confidential proposal: we’re asking to move Jonah Carter (ICs: SE-Eng) from the Growth infra org into the Partnerships org as an interim manager for the next 3 months while we search for a permanent hire. The reasons are a mix of capacity and a short-term cross-functional program with Acme Health that requires a hands-on technical manager who already knows the stack.

Why Jonah: quick ramp on the integration, strong stakeholder relationships with Acme, and recent peer-feedback shows he can handle a small manager load.

What I need from this thread:
- HR clearance for a temporary assignment + title/comp guidance (Laura)
- Executive approval for the interim manager window and any comp bands (Vivek)
- Confirmation from Partnerships that they accept a 3-month interim with Jonah reporting to them (Marissa)

I’ve attached a short proposal and a redacted performance summary. This is time-sensitive — Acme asks we provide a named lead by Nov 9 so the kickoff can proceed. Please reply with approvals/concerns by EOD Wed.

Attachments: manager_pivot_proposal.pdf (12KB), redacted_perf_summary_JC.pdf (8KB), org_chart_v3.png (420KB)

Thanks,
Olga

2) Any comp uplift required for interim manager duties (we can approve a one-time spot stipend up to $5k pending HR note).

Laura — can you advise on policy for temporary manager assignments and whether we need a written change to his offer/comp file?

Olga / Vivek — thanks for flagging. Partnerships can take Jonah as interim; I chatted with the product lead and we think a 3-month window is fine provided we ship the initial integration milestones. Two clarifying points:

- Scope: Jonah would own day-to-day for the Acme integration and manage a tethered contractor for QA. He will still be salaried under Growth but matrix-reporting to Partnerships for the program duration.
- Comp & title: we’re fine with interim manager title (Acting Manager, Partnerships). If there’s an additional stipend, please confirm asap so we can set expectations with Jonah.

Jillian — are you okay with Jonah as the named lead on Acme’s side? We wanted to give Acme a named point-of-contact for kickoff.

Marissa

Folks —

From HR-side: temporary matrix reporting is acceptable, we treat this as a temporary assignment and will add a short-term assignment record. Actions needed from your side:
1) Formal acceptance from Jonah in writing (we need a signed acknowledgement)
2) Org chart indicating reporting lines during the interim (I see org_chart_v3.png attached, please confirm final)
3) Any stipend or comp uplift needs rationale and approval; finance needs an expense tag.

For background checks / compliance: because Jonah will have manager-level access to customer data on this program, we require a refreshed background verification and a brief training completion (we can run both in parallel). Time estimate: 3 business days for checks once Jonah signs.

I’ll draft the short-term assignment form and route it to Jonah for signature once you confirm the stipend decision.

Laura Bennett
